1.web: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand, and his holy arm, have worked salvation for him.
1.asv: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.

2.web: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
2.asv: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.

3.web: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
3.asv: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

4.web: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
4.asv: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

5.web: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
5.asv: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.

6.web: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
6.asv: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.

7.web: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
7.asv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;

8.web: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
8.asv: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together

9.web: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
9.asv: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
